blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-derived 2026-07-30 at Ethereum block 25648380: the sUSN proxy 0xe24a3dc889621612422a64e6388927901608b91d still resolves to the Sourcify exact-match StakingVaultOFTUpgradeableHyperlane implementation 0xd1ffb6a6a42c86b931b2a6d388d1f25c1c775b34 behind ProxyAdmin 0x1908284b50ee152c9f00c8e65a81fc1c4520bd81. The verified source keeps a per-account blacklist mapping: blacklistAccount(address) (onlyRole(BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE)) sets it, and both the deposit path and _update revert with BlacklistedAddress when the sender or recipient is blacklisted, so a single privileged call freezes a named holder's sUSN on the canonical Ethereum deployment. On-chain reads at the same block: owner() = the Noon 3-of-6 admin Safe 0x1ea169EcCcf7714E7ba04900e1a3357cCA77327f and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, Safe) = true, so that Safe controls the blacklist surface (it can grant BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE at will; the Safe does not currently hold the manager role directly). The zkSync, Sophon, and Starknet deployments are Hyperlane lock-mint warp representations of this same token family, so a canonical-chain blacklist also traps their locked collateral. Upstream USN reserve-side exposure remains tracked on the parent usn-noon record.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Noon documents Ethereum sUSN as the canonical ERC-4626 wrapper and lock chain: sUSN inventory is locked on Ethereum, destination Hyperlane representations mint on accepted messages, and return transfers burn the representation before Ethereum unlocks the original. The zkSync, Sophon, and Starknet deployments are bridge representations, while Ethereum bridge configuration, pause/correction, upgrade, mailbox/ISM, and destination owner controls are scored here separately from native deposit-gated issuance.

routes.reviewNote: sUSN is native on Ethereum: the ERC-4626 wrapper mints only against deposited USN. Its cross-chain path separately locks wrapper inventory and unlocks it after accepted Hyperlane messages; those transfer-rail controls are reviewed below.

controls.label: Noon sUSN Ethereum lockbox and Hyperlane route Safe

routeChecks.lockboxOrEscrow: Noon documents Ethereum-to-destination lock-mint and destination-to-Ethereum burn-unlock. At Ethereum block 25771191, the current ERC-4626 cross-chain path locks wrapper inventory on Ethereum and unlocks it only after an accepted Hyperlane message; this is supply-conserving bridge escrow, not independent issuer-native minting.
routeChecks.trustedPeerOrRemote: The current implementation exposes owner-authorized Hyperlane mailbox, ISM, and remote-token configuration. The Ethereum mailbox is 0xc005dc82818d67af737725bd4bf75435d065d239, interchainSecurityModule() returns zero so the mailbox default ISM is effective, and the LayerZero Endpoint V2 is 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c. The default ISM validator set and quorum were not decoded.
routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: The Noon Safe owns the wrapper and administers the bridge configuration. The current implementation adds pause and a 48-hour stuck-message correction flow. Bridge-critical implementation replacement passes through ProxyAdmin 0x1908284b50ee152c9f00c8e65a81fc1c4520bd81 and timelock 0xe5e412c212b4fbbf550a94e7bd5e83db0b315a7f with a 172800-second delay owned by the same Safe.
routeChecks.onchainAmountBounds: Outbound transfers lock existing sUSN wrapper inventory and accepted return messages unlock that inventory; no independent canonical bridge mint path or route-level aggregate limit was verified.

controls.capDescription: The Noon Safe controls the Ethereum lockbox's bridge administration, Hyperlane/remote-token configuration, pause and stuck-message correction, while the ProxyAdmin/timelock path can replace bridge-critical logic after 172800 seconds. Native sUSN issuance remains deposit-gated.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771191 on 2026-08-16, the sUSN proxy resolved to implementation 0xebbcbc6672683e1956125e7c5e89e14ceac8cd3d, owner() was the Noon 3-of-6 Safe 0x1ea169ecccf7714e7ba04900e1a3357cca77327f, mailbox() was 0xc005dc82818d67af737725bd4bf75435d065d239, interchainSecurityModule() was zero, and LayerZero endpoint() was 0x1a44076050125825900e736c501f859c50fe728c. The verified implementation exposes owner-authorized Hyperlane configuration, remote-token handling, pause, and 48-hour stuck-message correction; ProxyAdmin 0x1908284b50ee152c9f00c8e65a81fc1c4520bd81 is governed by the 172800-second timelock 0xe5e412c212b4fbbf550a94e7bd5e83db0b315a7f. These are bridge-route controls over locked wrapper inventory, while native share issuance remains the deposit-gated Ethereum path in Mint Authority.
